clue.text: Mean little devil in blue

indicators.note: in places the little devil inside the word for blue

parts.note: the sky is blue, so blue gives SKY
an imp is a small mischievous devil

explanation.surface: A small demon dressed in blue is being stingy.
explanation.definitionFit: Mean in the sense of stingy or meagre matches skimpy, giving or containing too little.

clue.text: Second companion is asleep, keeping quiet: that's the drink

parts.note: CH stands for Companion of Honour

indicators.note: keeping means the asleep word holds the quiet letter inside it

parts.note: naps means is asleep, dozes
P is piano, the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: A friend who briefly dozes off silently has a drink to blame.
explanation.definitionFit: Schnapps is a strong alcoholic spirit, a kind of drink.

clue.text: Angry since Ned changed

indicators.note: changed says the letters of since Ned are altered into a different order

explanation.surface: Someone has been cross ever since Ned altered his ways.
explanation.definitionFit: Incensed is a synonym for furious, extremely annoyed.

clue.text: Type of fat parrot said to have room for more?

indicators.note: said means the parrot's name is spoken aloud and the spelling follows the sound

parts.note: Polly is the traditional name for a pet parrot
unsaturated means not yet full, able to absorb more

explanation.surface: A bird of the parrot kind supposedly still has space for another meal.
explanation.walkthrough: Polly is the stock name for a parrot; spoken, it gives POLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Polyunsaturated fats have several double bonds in their fatty acid chains, a recognised class of dietary fat.

clue.text: Break in journey south to prove chaotic

parts.note: S is the compass abbreviation for south

indicators.note: chaotic says the letters of to prove are thrown into disorder and rearranged

explanation.surface: Travelling south is going to turn out a mess, someone warns.
explanation.definitionFit: A stopover is a short stay somewhere partway through a longer trip, a pause in travel.

clue.text: Decorate tapestry's top edge

indicators.note: top picks the first letter, as the top of a down entry

parts.note: a rim is an edge or border

explanation.surface: Embellish the upper border of a woven wall hanging.
explanation.definitionFit: To trim is to adorn something with ornaments or edging, as in trimming a hat or a tree.

clue.text: Prophecy from pastor, incognito, going round

indicators.note: going round suggests the letters of pastor incognito are spun into a new order

explanation.surface: A vicar travelling around in disguise delivers a prediction.
explanation.definitionFit: A prognostication is a forecast of what will happen, which is what a prophecy is.

clue.text: Its player takes a bow

parts.note: not a performer bowing to applause but a musician picking up the stick strung with horsehair

explanation.walkthrough: Taking a bow suggests acknowledging applause; here the bow is the stick drawn across strings.
explanation.definitionFit: This stringed instrument is played with a bow drawn across its strings.

clue.text: Rogue artist's scrawl oddly ignored

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist, so artist's gives RA'S

indicators.note: oddly ignored means the odd-numbered letters of scrawl are dropped, keeping the even ones

explanation.surface: A painter's untidy writing is overlooked by a cheat.
explanation.definitionFit: A rascal is a dishonest or mischievous person, a rogue.

clue.text: Harass the man about deer making a comeback

parts.note: a man is referred to as he
C stands for circa, Latin for about

indicators.note: making a comeback means the deer word is read backwards, returning the way it came

parts.note: an elk is a large deer

explanation.surface: A man pestering a deer that keeps coming back.
explanation.definitionFit: To heckle is to interrupt and pester a speaker with jeers, a form of harassment.

clue.text: Our Tom is terribly fearful

indicators.note: terribly suggests the letters of Our Tom is are badly mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: Our friend Tom is very frightened.
explanation.definitionFit: Timorous is a synonym for timid, showing nervousness or fear.

clue.text: City area he left over level of command

parts.note: EC is the postcode for the City of London district
on can mean over, as in resting on top of

explanation.surface: A man departed the urban district once he was finished with leadership.
explanation.walkthrough: EC is the London postcode district covering the City, the capital's financial centre.
explanation.definitionFit: An echelon is a rank or tier in an organisation, especially a military one.

clue.text: Reveal article shown before news has little weight

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
N abbreviates new, so news supplies N
an ounce is a small unit of weight

explanation.surface: A newspaper item is published before the news is reported to carry little importance.
explanation.definitionFit: To announce is to make something public, to declare or disclose it.

clue.text: Pain again developed about noon

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters go around the letter for noon
developed suggests the letters of again are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: An ache came back once more around midday.
explanation.definitionFit: Angina is chest pain caused by reduced blood supply to the heart.

clue.text: Chemical engineers undermined by spy

indicators.note: undermined by places the spy word beneath the engineers in this down entry

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
an agent is a secret operative or spy

explanation.surface: Military engineers are sabotaged by an undercover operative using a chemical.
explanation.definitionFit: A reagent is a substance used to cause or detect a chemical reaction.

clue.text: Statement showing how to undo seat belt?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: an official announcement issued to the media
second meaning: press the release button of the buckle

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the playful second reading: you press the release to free a seat belt.
explanation.definitionFit: A press release is an official announcement handed to journalists by an organisation.

clue.text: Having a high opinion of maid playing with band

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters of maid are toyed with and rearranged

parts.note: a ring is a circular band

explanation.surface: Respecting a servant who performs with a music group.
explanation.definitionFit: Admiring means regarding with respect and approval, thinking highly of someone.

clue.text: Fan that's sticking

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a follower or supporter
second meaning: clinging or holding fast to a surface

explanation.walkthrough: The word is a noun for a supporter and an adjective meaning clinging, from adhere.
explanation.definitionFit: An adherent is a devoted supporter; as an adjective it means attached or clinging to something.

clue.text: Determined men did fancy following astronaut without weapon

indicators.note: following puts the rearranged letters after the trimmed name
without means the weapon is taken away from the astronaut's name

parts.note: Neil Armstrong was the first astronaut to walk on the Moon
an arm is a weapon, as in firearms

indicators.note: fancy suggests the letters of men did are given a fanciful new arrangement

explanation.surface: Resolute men imagined trailing a disarmed space traveller.
explanation.walkthrough: The astronaut is not a generic spaceman but a specific one: Neil Armstrong, first man on the Moon, whose surname contains a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: Strong-minded describes someone resolute who is not easily swayed, which is being determined.

clue.text: Reptile seen on American plant

indicators.note: seen on puts the reptile above the American abbreviation in this down entry

parts.note: croc is short for crocodile, a reptile
US is the United States, so American

explanation.surface: An alligator-like creature spotted on a US flower.
explanation.definitionFit: The crocus is a small spring-flowering plant grown from a corm.

clue.text: Actor's role in South Africa or part of Greece

indicators.note: in places the actor's role inside the abbreviation for South Africa

parts.note: a part is a role played by an actor

explanation.surface: A performer's character is set in South Africa or in a Greek region.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparta was an ancient city-state in the Peloponnese, a region of Greece.

clue.text: Rumour regarding Romeo getting into marijuana

parts.note: re means about or regarding, as in a letter heading

indicators.note: getting into places the Romeo letter inside the slang for marijuana

parts.note: pot is slang for marijuana
Romeo is R in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Gossip about a lover who has started using cannabis.
explanation.definitionFit: A report can be hearsay, an unverified account passed around, which is a rumour.

clue.text: Entering, is naive about welcoming first of visitors

indicators.note: welcoming means the jumbled letters take in the visitors' letter
about suggests the letters of is naive are turned about into a new order
first of picks the opening letter of visitors

explanation.surface: Someone innocent is described as fussing around guests as they arrive.
explanation.definitionFit: Invasive describes something that intrudes or spreads into territory, as when a species enters new ground.

clue.text: A very old name for flower

explanation.surface: An ancient name for a bloom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' is read as something that flows, a river: the Avon runs through Stratford in England.
explanation.definitionFit: In crosswords a flower is a river, since it flows; the Avon is an English river.

clue.text: Healing dog, one stops a vet cracking up

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog

indicators.note: stops means one plugs a gap inside the jumbled letters, like a stopper
cracking up suggests the letters of a vet break apart and reform

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A dog's recovery while a vet having a breakdown is halted by someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Curative means having the power to cure, so it describes something that heals.

clue.text: Heavenly guess

definitions.meaning: first meaning: of God or the heavens
second meaning: to work out by intuition

explanation.walkthrough: One word as an adjective for godly things and as a verb for discovering by insight.
explanation.definitionFit: Divine as an adjective means godlike; as a verb it means to discover by intuition or conjecture.

clue.text: Status isn't temporary

definitions.meaning: first meaning: rank or reputation in society

explanation.walkthrough: Read the second part as a description: something standing is lasting, not a stopgap.
explanation.definitionFit: Standing is social rank or reputation, and as an adjective means permanent, as in a standing committee.

clue.text: Man on board reported period of darkness

indicators.note: reported means the word is heard spoken rather than spelt, giving a soundalike

parts.note: night is the period of darkness between dusk and dawn

explanation.surface: A sailor told of a stretch of darkness at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man on board' suggests a ship, but the board is a chessboard.
explanation.definitionFit: A chess piece is called a man, and the knight is one of those pieces on the chessboard.
